name: shadow-hunters-ray
description: Shadow Hunters - jeu de plateau web multijoueur en temps réel

scripts.prisma:migrate:dev: cd packages/server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:migrate:deploy: cd packages/server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.server:build: cd packages/server && npx -p typescript tsc && npx prisma generate
scripts.build: npm run shared:build && npm run server:build && npm run client:build
scripts.server:dev: npm run shared:build && cd packages/server && npm run dev
scripts.test:all: npm run test:shared && npm run test:server && npm run test:client
